page.notes: Printed "gua" at the start of the page is a fragment of the previous page's paragraph and is kept as printed; it probably stands for "qua". Printed "preciofo" and "pafce" are kept as printed. "Quoniam" has its "Qu" underlined in the original, not marked here. The text has no notes in the margins.
